## Type of change

<!-- The PR title must follow Conventional Commits, e.g. "feat(contact): add phone field". -->

- [ ] feat / fix
- [ ] docs / style / refactor / perf / test
- [ ] build / ci / chore / revert

## Target branch

- [ ] `feature/*` or `bugfix/*` → `test` (squash merge)
- [ ] Promotion `test` → `stage` or `stage` → `main` (release managers, merge commit)
- [ ] `hotfix/*` → `main`, or back-merge `main` → `stage` / `test`

## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from `test` (or from `main` for a hotfix)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `typecheck`, `test:coverage`, `build` and `e2e` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated; coverage stays at or above 80%
- [ ] Accessibility checked (keyboard, focus, labels, contrast)
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour, scripts or configuration changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the diff
